malariafwd: concepts and terms

Source: R/malariafwd-package.R
malariafwd-package.Rd

malariafwd simulates Plasmodium vivax transmission and genetics forward in time in SLiM, one host, mosquito and parasite genome at a time, and reads what a run records from R. This page defines the terms the help pages share.

Start here

example_run() returns a small run that ships with the package, so every function that reads a run can be tried without SLiM. vignette("malariafwd") shows how to run a simulation and reads the bundled run, vignette("parameters") gives the parameters that are easy to get wrong and how to choose them, and vignette("anatomy") walks through what a run records (all three are also on the website); event_types() lists every event a run logs. The model is described in full in MODEL_DESCRIPTION, the reasons for its choices are in design decisions, and the scripts that validate the model are installed in system.file("validation", package = "malariafwd").

Runs and their tables

A run is one simulation: run_sim() writes it to a directory, and load_run() reads that directory back as a vivax_run. Every function that reads a run takes either. A run's outputs are four files, each read by its own function: params.tsv, the parameter set it was made from (load_params()); events.tsv, one row per event (load_events(), described in events.tsv); state.tsv, every host and mosquito on every day (load_state(), hosts by default); and plasmo.trees, the genealogy of every genome as a tree sequence (trees_path()). An argument named events takes an events table or a run, one named state a state table or a run, and a plot takes a run or the table its function returns.

Time

A tick is one day. A run's days are 1 to SIM_DAYS, and every column named *_tick is a day. Most durations are geometric: a state with a mean duration of D days ends on each day with probability 1/D. EIP_DAYS and GAMETOCYTE_DELAY are fixed delays, RECRUD_DELAY_DIST sets the shape of a recrudescence's delay, and with K_LATENCY above 0 a batch's latency is a sequence of geometric stages. A year is 365 days, so a rate per person-year divides by person-days over 365.

Genomes and identifiers

Each parasite genome is one individual of the simulation. A bite, an import, a relapse and a recrudescence each make a new genome, and a batch of hypnozoites is one genome that stands for its count. pedigree_id names a genome, uniquely within a run; it is 0 or more, and -1 means none. lineage_id names a clonal group: a genome keeps its parent's lineage through clonal and selfed descent, and a recombinant starts a new one. In this package lineage always means this group; the genealogy itself is the tree sequence. oocyst_id names one meiosis in a mosquito, human_id and mosq_id a host and a mosquito, and entity_id either of them in state.tsv.

Cases, episodes and acquisitions

A case is a clone onset, one row of classify_cases(): a bite or an import that gave a blood-stage infection, a relapse, or a recrudescence. Founder seeding, where a run starts, is not a case. An episode is the clones that became patent in one host on one day, named by episode_id, "<human_id>:<tick>", so a bite that delivered two genotypes is two cases of one episode (episodes(), recurrences()). An acquisition is a case that began a new blood-stage clone in its host: an import, a local reinfection or a relapse. A recrudescence is a case but not an acquisition, since it re-expands a clone already counted. A relapse into a patent clone of its own lineage is flagged by into_patent_lineage, and exclude_masked = TRUE leaves such relapses out of the counts.

COI and MOI

Here the complexity of infection (COI) and the multiplicity of infection (MOI) are one quantity: the distinct patent blood-stage lineages in a host, moi_active in state.tsv. MAX_MOI gates new inoculations: a host already carrying that many blood-stage lineages, patent or subpatent, takes no new bite or import. Relapses bypass it, and a bite that delivers several genotypes is admitted whole, so a host's COI can exceed it.

Transmission

A transmission link joins a parent genome of an oocyst to a genome its products infected: direct, through a bite's blood stage, or liver, through a relapse of the batch a bite left. transmission_links() lists them, each with its chain, a connected group of links. Rc, the case reproduction number, is the mean number of secondary cases per case, by true origin (rc_by_origin()). classify_chain() classes each case by its true chain from an import, and classify_travel() by what a rule that knows only travel history would conclude.

Relatedness

Every genome descends from root genomes, which are unrelated: the founder templates, one per founder lineage (N_FOUNDER_LINEAGES), and the imports. The founder hosts of one lineage carry clonal copies of its template. So the genealogy is a forest. Identity by descent (IBD) is read from it exactly: ibd_pairs() for pairs, ibd_segments() for the stretches behind them, and ibd_lookup() to read a pair. arg_tmrca() gives how far back two genomes share an ancestor, and arg_summary() the shape of the forest.
